question: Why is that covering other-form and not-other?
premises: It is burnable by Shiva fire-ray nets.
It is other-form because of not-this priority.
It colors by own self, therefore not other.
inference: The covering is distinct yet not ultimately other from self.
plain_english: Because it is burnable by Shiva's fire-ray nets, that covering is other-form by not-this priority; since it colors by own self, it is not other.
